paper.title_en: Quantum corrections to the black hole entropy using the brick wall model
paper.abstract_en: It was suggested by 't Hooft that to avoid the divergence of the free energy or entropy of the probe fields, one has to introduce an infrared (IR) cutoff. This introduction of the IR cutoff, namely, the brick wall model, has been studied for the Schwarzschild black hole and has been shown by 't Hooft that to have the entropy of the order of Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, the cutoff must be of the order of Planck length. In this study, we investigated the brick wall model in the context of a Reissner-Nordstróm, quantum corrected Schwarzschild and quantum corrected Reissner-Nordström black holes. In particular, we have shown that the brick wall model can give logarithmic correction to the black hole entropy in the subleading order. The important aspect of our analysis is that we have not considered the near horizon approximation of the lapse function and get more accurate correction to the entropy. This corrected entropy has an important feature that it is larger than the usual Bekenstein-Hawking entropy which aligns with the result of Barrow entropy.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了砖墙模型在多种黑洞背景下对熵的量子修正，并给出了对数修正，讨论较为深入，具有一定的新颖性。论文虽无引用，但考虑到其新鲜度，这不影响其入选。
decision.title_zh: 利用砖墙模型对黑洞熵的量子修正
decision.abstract_zh: 特胡夫特提出，为了避免探针场的自由能或熵的发散，必须引入一个红外（IR）截断。这种红外截断的引入，即砖墙模型，已在Schwarzschild黑洞的背景下进行研究，并且特胡夫特已经证明，要使熵的量级与Bekenstein-Hawking熵相当，截断必须取普朗克长度的量级。在本研究中，我们研究了Reissner-Nordstróm、量子修正的Schwarzschild和量子修正的Reissner-Nordström黑洞背景下的砖墙模型。特别是，我们已经证明，砖墙模型可以在次领头阶对黑洞熵给出对数修正。我们分析的重要方面是，我们没有考虑lapse函数的近地平线近似，从而得到了对熵的更精确的修正。这个修正后的熵有一个重要的特征，即它大于通常的Bekenstein-Hawking熵，这与Barrow熵的结果一致。
